decision.explanation: The source documents present two distinct, contradictory assertions regarding the origin of 'Zoobles!'. Document 1 (D1S3, D1S4, D1S8) explicitly states the series originates from Brazil, citing Brazilian animators and the Ministry of Culture. Document 2 (D2S6, D2S11) explicitly states the series originates from South Korea, citing Seoul-based production and SamG Animation. As per the instruction to treat all audits and saved answers as fallible and to preserve separately valid referents without inventing restrictions, both 'Brazil' and 'South Korea' are retained as valid answers derived directly from the provided text segments, representing the competing claims found in the source material.
